Graves

ADC Weird but works

ADC Graves (S3 classic)

How to play this build

You're an early-dominance ADC: get close to land full Buckshot (Q) on the enemy and use Smoke Screen (W) to blind in the all-in. Quickdraw (E) gives attack speed and repositioning. Snowball your lane lead; late game you have less range than others, so play with your team.

Skill order

Max priority:

Q Descarga → E Movimiento Rápido → W Cortina de Humo

The ultimate (R) is always leveled at 6, 11 and 16.

Level 123456789101112131415161718
Q QQQQQ
W WWWWW
E EEEEE
R RRR
Why this order
Buckshot (Q) for burst; Quickdraw (E) second for attack speed. W (blind) at 1 point.

Items and what they do

  1. Berserker's Greaves Boots granting attack speed.
  2. Infinity Edge High AD, crit and increased crit damage. Core of almost every ADC.
  3. The Black Cleaver AD and health; your hits stack armor shred on the target.
  4. Youmuu's Ghostblade AD, crit and CDR; active gives a burst of attack speed and move speed to assassinate.
  5. Phantom Dancer Attack speed, crit and move speed; ignores unit collision.
  6. The Bloodthirster High AD and lifesteal; forms a shield when at full health.

Masteries: how they work

In Season 3 you have up to 30 points (at level 30) to split across three trees: Offense (damage), Defense (durability) and Utility (mana, cooldown reduction and mobility). The notation 21/0/9 means 21 points in Offense, 0 in Defense and 9 in Utility.

Masteries
21/9/0 — Offense
Why this page
21/9/0 boosts early Buckshot burst to dominate the lane.
